claims: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost approximately $4.1 to $4.2 billion per launch.
The estimated cost for the Artemis II mission includes the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis program runs from 2012 to 2025.
The Artemis program is projected to cost roughly $93 billion.
The per launch cost for Artemis II is approximately $4.2 billion.
The per launch cost for Artemis II includes rocket, capsule, and mission operations.
The Orion capsule cost is projected at $9.3 billion total through the second flight.
The total program estimate for Artemis is approximately $93 billion through 2025.
The Artemis program is primarily funded by the U.S. federal government through NASA.
